note: Accuracy and framing report for the decision corpus. Values are measurements of task value against ground truth; winner agreement, Brier and ECE are recomputed by tools/server/tests/test_decision_accuracy.py. Producer confidence never gates a request. Every model block here was measured on the frozen 240-case corpus with the harness's current key names; a block measured on the earlier 12-case corpus was removed rather than left to be compared against these numbers.

margin.derivation: 2 x the widest control CI half-width (0.0847, qwen3.5-2b), which is the smallest multiple clearing every control's own lower bound (qwen -0.1525, gemma -0.1017); above the 0.05 absolute floor

measured.split: calibration for the margins, holdout for the verdict

verdict.outcome: keep the letter readout: the value readout is worse on every model, the lfm holdout lower bound is below the frozen non-inferiority margin, and no model reaches the frozen lfm superiority margin
